data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $106,371,000 (2022: $75,625,000) is a deterioration of $10,197,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2022: deterioration $10,434,000).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate shows a net gross prior-year strengthening of approximately 17.675 million (USD) for accident years 2019-2021 (excluding 2022 and 2023), driven by increases in the gross incurred estimates for the 2019 and 2020 underwriting years partially offset by a release on 2021. Management attributes the backyear deterioration to updated IBNR assumptions, an inflation loading and a margin added above actuarial best estimates as part of a reserving methodology update; the report also records a net deterioration of $10.197m in prior year claims on a net-of-reinsurance basis.
raw_causal_phrases: we have therefore made a provision within claims that have been incurred at the reporting date but have not yet been reported ("IBNR") in the calendar year to allow for this reserving uncertainty.

the assumptions underlying our reserving methodology reflect additional information obtained from pricing current and prospective business. The implications of this analysis have been incorporated into our reserving approach for all years of account which, together with a loading for inflation and a margin added over and above actuarial best estimates, has contributed to the back year deterioration on the 2020 and prior years of account on a stand-alone basis.

Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $106,371,000 (2022: $75,625,000) is a deterioration of $10,197,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2022: deterioration $10,434,000).
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (claims outstanding, prior-year column). Prior-year development computed from the gross claims development triangle (gross incurred triangle) comparing current estimate to previous diagonal excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2023, 2022). The report also states a net deterioration of $10.197m in prior year reserves (this net figure is after reinsurance). The syndicate operated as a SPA for earlier years with transactions undertaken by Syndicate 1969; this RITC/SPA arrangement may distort development patterns. Where LOB-specific prior-year movements are not quantified, amounts are left null.
